scene: Five adults queue in a straight line facing right toward the counter. The person standing first, right beside the counter, wears a plain brimmed hat; the other four, stretching back to the left edge, have bare heads. All are the same size and evenly spaced.
must: the hat-wearer standing first, next to the counter.
avoid: the hat-wearer standing last (achteraan); the hat-wearer in the middle (midden); a person standing alone at the counter with no queue (not the card); a person cutting in from the side (not the card).
contrast: Pair with achteraan. The only difference is the hat: on the first person next to the counter here, on the last person far from it there.
example_nl: Vooraan in de rij staat een oude man.
example_en: At the front of the queue stands an old man.
alt: Vijf mensen staan in een rij naar een loket; de eerste, naast het loket, draagt een hoed.

scene: Five adults queue in a straight line facing right toward the counter. The person standing last, farthest from the counter at the left edge, wears a plain brimmed hat; the other four, leading up to the counter, have bare heads. All are the same size and evenly spaced.
must: the hat-wearer standing last, far from the counter.
avoid: the hat-wearer standing first (vooraan); the hat-wearer in the middle (midden); a person walking away from the queue (not the card); a person turned around facing the other way (not the card).
contrast: Pair with vooraan. The only difference is the hat: on the last person far from the counter here, on the first person next to it there.
example_nl: Ga maar achteraan in de rij staan.
example_en: Go and stand at the back of the queue.
alt: Vijf mensen staan in een rij naar een loket; de laatste, het verst van het loket, draagt een hoed.

scene: The plain ten-step staircase rises to the right and the adult stands on the top step at the edge of the flat landing, one hand on the handrail, looking down the steps. The bottom of the stairs and the floor are empty.
must: the person on the topmost step at the landing, looking down the stairs.
avoid: the person on the bottom step (onderaan); the person on the fifth step, halfway up (halverwege); the person on an upper floor with no staircase shown (boven); the person on the roof (buiten).
contrast: Pair with onderaan and halverwege. The only difference is the step: the topmost step at the landing here, the bottom step or the fifth step there.
example_nl: Hij wacht bovenaan.
example_en: He is waiting at the top.
alt: Een man staat op de hoogste trede met een hand op de leuning en kijkt de trap af.

scene: The plain ten-step staircase rises to the right and the adult stands on the fifth step, about halfway between the floor and the landing, one hand on the handrail, looking up the steps. The landing at the top and the floor at the bottom are both empty.
must: the person on the fifth step, about halfway between the floor and the landing.
avoid: the person on the top step (bovenaan); the person on the bottom step (onderaan); the person on the second step, close to the floor (not the card); the person sitting on a step (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bovenaan and onderaan. The only difference is the step: the fifth step here, the topmost step or the bottom step there.
example_nl: Halverwege stopt hij even.
example_en: Halfway he stops for a moment.
alt: Een man staat op de middelste trede van een trap met een hand op de leuning en kijkt naar de overloop.

scene: The plain ten-step staircase rises to the right and the adult stands on the bottom step at the edge of the flat floor, one hand on the handrail, looking up the steps. The top landing is empty.
must: the person on the lowest step at the floor, looking up the stairs.
avoid: the person on the top step (bovenaan); the person on the fifth step, halfway up (halverwege); the person on the lower floor with no staircase shown (beneden); the person crawling on the floor (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bovenaan and halverwege. The only difference is the step: the bottom step on the floor here, the topmost step or the fifth step there.
example_nl: Zij wacht onderaan.
example_en: She is waiting at the bottom.
alt: Een man staat op de laagste trede met een hand op de leuning en kijkt de trap op.

scene: The plain car seen from straight above with its roof removed shows the four seats in two rows. The driver sits at the wheel in the front left seat, and the child sits in the front right seat beside the driver, seat belt across the chest. Both back seats are empty.
must: the child in the front row beside the driver, both back seats empty.
avoid: the child in the back row (achterin); the child on the driver's lap (not the card); the child in the boot (not the card); the child outside the car (buiten).
contrast: Pair with achterin. The only difference is the seat: the child sits in the front row beside the driver here, in the back row there.
example_nl: Je moet voorin zitten, anders word je ziek.
example_en: You have to sit in the front, otherwise you will get sick.
alt: Een auto van bovenaf zonder dak; een kind zit met een riem om naast de bestuurder en de stoelen op de tweede rij zijn leeg.

scene: The plain car seen from straight above with its roof removed shows the four seats in two rows. The driver sits at the wheel in the front left seat, and the child sits in the back right seat, seat belt across the chest. The front seat beside the driver is empty.
must: the child in the back row, the seat beside the driver empty.
avoid: the child in the front row beside the driver (voorin); the child lying across the seats (not the card); the child in the boot (not the card); the child outside the car (buiten).
contrast: Pair with voorin. The only difference is the seat: the child sits in the back row here, in the front row beside the driver there.
example_nl: De kinderen zitten achterin.
example_en: The children are sitting in the back.
alt: Een auto van bovenaf zonder dak; een kind zit met een riem om op de tweede rij en de stoel naast de bestuurder is leeg.

scene: The plain wide street shows the adult standing exactly halfway between the two kerbs, arms hanging, facing the viewer, while the cyclist rides down the middle of the street toward the adult's back, still far off. Nothing else is on the street.
must: the person standing mid-street, in the cyclist's path.
avoid: the person up on the kerb (opzij); the person lying on the road (not the card); the person at the far end of the street (ver); two people in the street (not the frame).
contrast: Pair with opzij. The only difference is the place: in the middle of the street here, up on the kerb there.
example_nl: Het huis staat midden in het dorp.
example_en: The house stands in the middle of the village.
alt: Een man staat precies tussen de twee stoepranden; achter hem komt een fietser aan.

scene: The plain wide street shows the adult standing up on the left kerb, arms hanging, facing the viewer, while the cyclist rides down the middle of the street toward the viewer, still far off, the whole road clear. Nothing else is on the street.
must: the person up on the kerb, the road clear for the cyclist.
avoid: the person standing in the middle of the street (midden); the person walking away along the street (not the card); the person hiding behind a wall (not the card); the person lying on the pavement (not the card).
contrast: Pair with midden. The only difference is the place: up on the kerb here, in the middle of the street there.
example_nl: Ga even opzij, ik wil erdoor.
example_en: Step aside for a moment, I want to get through.
alt: Een man staat op de stoeprand; over de lege weg komt een fietser aan.

scene: The plain mug with a handle stands on its flat base on the plain table, seen from the side, its open top facing the ceiling and the handle to the right. Nothing else is on the table, and the wall behind is plain.
must: a mug standing on its base with the open top up.
avoid: a mug standing on its rim (ondersteboven); a mug lying on its side (plat); a very tall mug (hoog); a mug being filled from a jug (not the card).
contrast: Pair with ondersteboven. The only difference is the mug: on its base with the open top up here, on its rim with the base up there.
example_nl: Ga rechtop zitten, dan heb je geen pijn.
example_en: Sit up straight, then you will not have pain.
alt: Een beker staat met de bodem op de tafel; de open kant wijst naar het plafond.

scene: The plain mug with a handle stands on its rim on the plain table, seen from the side, its flat base facing the ceiling and the handle to the right. Nothing else is on the table, and the wall behind is plain.
must: a mug standing on its rim with the base up.
avoid: a mug standing on its base (rechtop); a mug lying on its side (plat); a mug falling through the air (not the card); an empty mug with drops (leeg).
contrast: Pair with rechtop. The only difference is the mug: on its rim with the base up here, on its base with the open top up there.
example_nl: De fiets ligt ondersteboven in de sloot.
example_en: The bike is lying upside down in the ditch.
alt: Een beker staat met de rand op de tafel; de bodem wijst naar het plafond.

scene: The adult cycles to the right on the plain bicycle. The child sits in the small seat at the handlebar, between the adult's arms, both hands on the seat's front bar. The seat over the back wheel is empty. The road and the low wall behind are plain.
must: the child in the seat at the handlebar, the back seat empty.
avoid: the child in the seat over the back wheel (achterop); the child riding a bike of its own (not the card); the child walking beside the bike (not the card); the child in a trailer behind the bike (not the card).
contrast: Pair with achterop. The only difference is the seat: the child sits at the handlebar here, over the back wheel there.
example_nl: Mijn zoontje zit graag voorop.
example_en: My little son likes sitting on the front.
alt: Een vrouw fietst met een kind in het zitje bij het stuur, tussen haar armen; het zitje bij de bagagedrager is leeg.

scene: The adult cycles to the right on the plain bicycle. The child sits in the small seat over the back wheel, behind the adult's back, hands holding the seat's sides. The seat at the handlebar is empty. The road and the low wall behind are plain.
must: the child in the seat over the back wheel, the front seat empty.
avoid: the child in the seat at the handlebar (voorop); the child pedalling a second bike behind (not the card); the child running behind the bike (not the card); the child standing next to a parked bike (not the card).
contrast: Pair with voorop. The only difference is the seat: the child sits over the back wheel here, at the handlebar there.
example_nl: Spring maar achterop, ik breng je thuis.
example_en: Hop on the back, I will take you home.
alt: Een vrouw fietst met een kind in het zitje bij de bagagedrager, vlak bij haar rug; het zitje bij het stuur is leeg.

scene: The straight forest path is seen from a high viewpoint. The fallen tree trunk lies at a right angle to the path, from one edge straight to the other, closing the whole width like a gate. The rows of tree trunks along both edges are unchanged and nothing else is on the path.
must: a trunk lying at a right angle across the path.
avoid: a trunk lying at a slant across the path (schuin); a trunk lying along the path (not the card); a tree still standing at the edge (rechtop); a pile of cut logs (not the card).
contrast: Pair with schuin. The only difference is the angle: the trunk lies at a right angle to the path here, at a slant there. Cross-reference: Voorzetselpaden B1+ draws a tree dwars over de weg and one car dwars in a row of schuin parked cars; the taught items differ.
example_nl: De auto staat dwars op de weg.
example_en: The car is standing across the road.
alt: Een boomstam ligt haaks op een recht bospad en sluit de hele breedte af.

scene: The straight forest path is seen from a high viewpoint. The fallen tree trunk lies at a slant over the path, one end at the left edge near the bottom, the other end at the right edge much higher up. The rows of tree trunks along both edges are unchanged and nothing else is on the path.
must: a trunk lying at a clear slant over the path.
avoid: a trunk lying at a right angle across the path (dwars); a trunk lying along the path (not the card); a tree leaning against another tree (not the card); a trunk with a bend in it (krom).
contrast: Pair with dwars. The only difference is the angle: the trunk lies at a slant over the path here, at a right angle there.
example_nl: Steek de straat niet zomaar schuin over.
example_en: Do not just cross the street diagonally.
alt: Een boomstam ligt in een hoek over een recht bospad, van linksvoor naar rechtsachter.

scene: The cutaway landscape shows the plain metro train inside the round tunnel deep in the earth, wheels on the lower track, lit windows drawn as plain outlines. The railway track on the ground surface between the houses is empty. The houses and the earth layers are unchanged.
must: the train inside the tunnel deep in the earth, the surface track empty.
avoid: the train on the track between the houses (bovengronds); a train on a high bridge (not the card); a train going into a tunnel mouth (not the card); a cellar under a house (beneden).
contrast: Pair with bovengronds. The only difference is the place of the train: in the tunnel deep in the earth here, on the track between the houses there.
example_nl: In de stad rijdt de metro ondergronds.
example_en: In the city the metro runs underground.
alt: Een trein rijdt door een tunnel diep in de aarde; de rails tussen de huizen zijn leeg.

scene: The cutaway landscape shows the plain metro train on the railway track on the ground surface, running between the plain houses. The round tunnel deep in the earth below is empty, its lower track bare. The houses and the earth layers are unchanged.
must: the train on the track between the houses, the tunnel below empty.
avoid: the train inside the tunnel deep in the earth (ondergronds); a train on a high bridge (not the card); a bus on the road (not the card); a train standing at a platform with people (not the card).
contrast: Pair with ondergronds. The only difference is the place of the train: on the track between the houses here, in the tunnel deep in the earth there.
example_nl: Buiten het centrum rijdt de metro bovengronds.
example_en: Outside the centre the metro runs above ground.
alt: Een trein rijdt over de rails tussen de huizen; de tunnel diep in de aarde is leeg.

scene: The plain street of five joined houses is seen from the front. The adult stands at the door of the first house on the left, arms hanging, facing the viewer. The small shop with loaves in its window is the second house, directly to the right of the adult's house and touching its wall. The other houses are plain.
must: the bread shop joined to the adult's own house.
avoid: the bread shop at the far end of the row (verderop); the bread shop across the street (not the card); the adult inside the shop (binnen); the adult walking down the street (onderweg).
contrast: Pair with verderop. The only difference is the shop's place: directly next to the adult's house here, at the far end of the row there.
example_nl: Mijn beste vriendin woont hiernaast.
example_en: My best friend lives next door.
alt: Een man staat bij zijn voordeur; de winkel met broden in de etalage zit direct tegen zijn huis.

scene: The plain street of five joined houses is seen from the front. The adult stands at the door of the first house on the left, arms hanging, facing the viewer. The small shop with loaves in its window is the fifth house, at the far right end of the row, three plain houses between. The other houses are plain.
must: the bread shop at the far end of the row, three houses between.
avoid: the bread shop joined to the adult's own house (hiernaast); the bread shop tiny on the horizon (ver); the bread shop across the street (not the card); the adult walking to the shop (onderweg).
contrast: Pair with hiernaast. The only difference is the shop's place: at the far end of the row here, directly next to the adult's house there.
example_nl: De bushalte is een stukje verderop.
example_en: The bus stop is a little further on.
alt: Een man staat bij zijn voordeur; de winkel met broden in de etalage is het laatste huis van de rij.

scene: The adult walks on the frozen pavement in small careful steps, both feet on the ice, knees slightly bent, arms held out wide for balance, body upright. The ice patches, the low wall and the bare tree behind are unchanged. Nothing lies on the ground.
must: a person upright on both feet on the ice, arms out for balance.
avoid: a person slipping, feet flying forward (onderuit); a person sitting on a bench (zitten); a person skating fast with speed lines (snel); a person standing still on dry ground (not the card).
contrast: Pair with onderuit. The only difference is the body: upright on both feet here, feet flying forward and body tipping back there.
example_nl: Hij bleef met moeite overeind.
example_en: He only just managed to stay on his feet.
alt: Een man loopt met kleine stapjes op een bevroren stoep, armen wijd, en staat nog op beide voeten.

scene: The adult is caught mid-slip on the frozen pavement: both feet shoot forward off the ice patch, the body tips back in the air above the ground, arms flung up, mouth open in surprise. The ice patches, the low wall and the bare tree behind are unchanged. Nothing lies on the ground.
must: a person in mid-slip, both feet shooting forward off the ice, body tipped back in the air.
avoid: a person upright on both feet on the ice (overeind); a person already lying still on the ground (not the card); a person sprawled at ease in a chair (not the card); a person jumping on purpose (not the card).
contrast: Pair with overeind. The only difference is the body: feet flying forward and body tipping back here, upright on both feet there. Taught as onderuit (gaan): the verb onderuitgaan (rank 9745) is taken by this card and is not carded elsewhere.
example_nl: Op het gladde ijs ging zij onderuit.
example_en: On the slippery ice she fell over.
alt: Een man glijdt weg op een bevroren stoep: zijn voeten schieten naar voren en hij valt naar achteren, met open mond.

scene: The adult sits on the plain wooden chair, feet flat and hands on the thighs, with the upper body tipped back against the backrest, shoulders well behind the hips and the face turned up toward the ceiling. The chair legs stay on the floor. The wall behind is plain.
must: a seated person with the upper body tipped back against the backrest.
avoid: a seated person bent forward toward the knees (voorover); a person sitting straight (rechtop); a chair tipping over backward (not the card); a person lying on a sofa (not the card).
contrast: Pair with voorover. The only difference is the lean: the upper body tips back against the backrest here, bends forward toward the knees there.
example_nl: Hij leunt lekker achterover in zijn stoel.
example_en: He leans back comfortably in his chair.
alt: Een man zit op een stoel en leunt met zijn rug tegen de leuning, zijn gezicht naar het plafond.

scene: The adult sits on the plain wooden chair, feet flat and hands on the thighs, with the upper body bent forward far over the knees, the back clear of the backrest and the face turned down toward the floor. The chair is unchanged. The wall behind is plain.
must: a seated person bent forward over the knees, back clear of the backrest.
avoid: a seated person tipped back against the backrest (achterover); a person sitting straight (rechtop); a person falling off the chair (onderuit); a person kneeling on the floor (not the card).
contrast: Pair with achterover. The only difference is the lean: the upper body bends forward toward the knees here, tips back against the backrest there.
example_nl: Zij buigt voorover om haar veters te strikken.
example_en: She bends forward to tie her laces.
alt: Een man zit op een stoel met zijn bovenlijf ver naar zijn knieën gebogen; zijn rug raakt de leuning niet.

scene: The small plain motor boat floats on the calm lake. The adult in the life jacket stands upright on the flat deck, one hand on the low rail, looking ahead. The water beside the boat is calm and empty, and the low grassy bank at the left is empty.
must: a person standing on the deck, one hand on the rail.
avoid: a person in the water beside the boat (overboord); a person standing on the grassy bank beside the boat (aan wal); a person swimming far from any boat (not the card); a person climbing a ladder into the boat (not the card).
contrast: Pair with overboord. The only difference is the adult's place: standing on the deck here, in the water beside the boat there. Vaste uitdrukkingen aan-wal borrows this frame and names both cards: change it with this set.
example_nl: Alle passagiers zijn nu aan boord.
example_en: All passengers are on board now.
alt: Een man met een zwemvest staat op het dek van een kleine boot en houdt de reling vast.

scene: The small plain motor boat floats on the calm lake. The adult in the life jacket is in the water just beside the boat, head and one raised arm above the surface, small splash rings around him. The flat deck is empty, and the low grassy bank at the left is empty.
must: a person in the water beside the boat, the deck empty.
avoid: a person standing on the deck (aan boord); a person diving neatly from the boat (not the card); a person swimming far from the boat (not the card); a person fishing from the deck (not the card).
contrast: Pair with aan-boord. The only difference is the adult's place: in the water beside the boat here, standing on the deck there. Vaste uitdrukkingen aan-wal borrows this frame and names both cards: change it with this set.
example_nl: Tijdens de storm sloeg een man overboord.
example_en: During the storm a man went overboard.
alt: Een man met een zwemvest ligt naast een kleine boot in het water en steekt een arm omhoog; het dek is leeg.

scene: The tall plain cupboard stands with both doors open and its five shelves showing. The plain mug stands alone on the highest shelf, close to the top of the cupboard. The four shelves below are empty. The floor in front of the cupboard is bare.
must: a mug alone on the highest shelf of an open cupboard.
avoid: a mug alone on the lowest shelf (onderin); a mug standing on top of the closed cupboard (bovenop); a mug on the middle shelf (midden); a full cupboard (vol).
contrast: Pair with onderin. The only difference is the shelf: the highest shelf here, the lowest shelf there.
example_nl: Zoek maar bovenin, daar ligt het.
example_en: Just look at the top, that is where it is.
alt: Een open kast met vijf planken; een beker staat op de hoogste plank en de andere planken zijn leeg.

scene: The tall plain cupboard stands with both doors open and its five shelves showing. The plain mug stands alone on the lowest shelf, just above the floor. The four shelves above are empty. The floor in front of the cupboard is bare.
must: a mug alone on the lowest shelf of an open cupboard.
avoid: a mug alone on the highest shelf (bovenin); a mug on the floor in front of the cupboard (not the card); a mug on the middle shelf (midden); an empty cupboard (leeg).
contrast: Pair with bovenin. The only difference is the shelf: the lowest shelf here, the highest shelf there.
example_nl: De zware dozen zet je onderin.
example_en: You put the heavy boxes at the bottom.
alt: Een open kast met vijf planken; een beker staat op de laagste plank, vlak bij de vloer, en de andere planken zijn leeg.
